name: Creative Tech Summit 2026
description: Join designers, developers, and creative technologists for a full day of talks, hands-on workshops, and conversations about the ideas shaping the future of digital experiences.

host.name: Maya Chen
host.title: Creative technologist & community builder
host.bio: Maya brings creative teams together to explore how emerging technology can make digital experiences more human. She has spent the last decade building products and organizing events for the design community.

highlights: Hear practical perspectives from leaders in design and engineering
Take part in a hands-on prototyping workshop
Meet and collaborate with a community of creative technologists

agenda.title: Doors open & coffee
agenda.description: Check in, grab a coffee, and meet fellow attendees.

agenda.title: Designing for what comes next
agenda.description: A keynote on building thoughtful experiences with emerging technology.

agenda.title: From idea to interactive prototype
agenda.description: A practical, collaborative workshop led by the summit speakers.

agenda.title: Community showcase & closing
agenda.description: Share what you made and continue the conversation.

name: The Future of Responsible AI
description: Explore practical ways to build AI products that are transparent, inclusive, and useful. This online event brings together product leaders and researchers for a focused afternoon of talks and audience Q&A.

host.name: Jordan Rivera
host.title: AI product researcher
host.bio: Jordan works with research and product teams to make AI systems more understandable and accountable. He regularly hosts conversations that connect technical research with real-world product decisions.

highlights: Learn practical approaches to responsible AI product design
Hear perspectives from researchers and product teams
Join a live audience Q&A from anywhere

agenda.title: Welcome & introduction
agenda.description: Get oriented and meet the speakers in the online event space.

agenda.title: Building trust into AI products
agenda.description: A practical talk on transparency, user expectations, and responsible design.

agenda.title: Research panel & audience Q&A
agenda.description: Discuss current challenges with the speakers and attendees.

agenda.title: Closing reflections
agenda.description: Key takeaways and resources to continue learning.

name: Product Makers Community Day
description: Spend a day learning, sharing, and connecting with product makers. Attend in person in San Francisco or join the talks and community sessions online.

host.name: Alex Morgan
host.title: Product strategist & community organizer
host.bio: Alex helps teams turn ambitious ideas into products people love. She also brings product communities together to share lessons, build new connections, and support one another.

highlights: Choose an in-person or online way to participate
Join interactive sessions with product practitioners
Connect with a welcoming community of makers

agenda.title: Welcome & community coffee
agenda.description: Meet attendees in person or join the online networking room.

agenda.title: Making products with purpose
agenda.description: Stories and lessons from teams building meaningful products.

agenda.title: Interactive maker sessions
agenda.description: Small-group discussions available both onsite and online.

agenda.title: Showcase & closing
agenda.description: Share ideas from the day and wrap up together.
